sections.changelog:
• 26.11.16 - Fix: Resolved undefined array key "_royal_use_counterz" PHP warning in RoyalCounterz extension.
  • 26.11.15 - Fix: Resolved missing SweetAlert2 vendor assets (sweetalert2.min.css & sweetalert2.all.min.js) by updating git ignore rules to ensure assets/vendor files are packaged and distributed properly in updates.
  • 26.11.14 - Fix: Prevented Royal Popup widget FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content) where popup briefly flashed/rendered at the bottom of the page before stylesheets load.
  • 26.11.13 - Royal Popup Widget Major Modernization: Page-Level Display Targeting (This Page Only, Specific Pages, All Single Posts), new triggers (After Page Scroll with depth %, After Inactivity idle detection, Open Delay for Page Load), Smart Cookie Rules (disable for testing, Session cookie, Cookie Per Page Only), Interactive Close Actions (.royal-popup-close-btn, data-royal-popup-close, Close on Overlay/ESC toggles), Hide on Mobile toggle, and Preview in Editor mode.
  • 26.11.12 - WordPress Automatic Updates support in plugins dashboard (enable/disable auto-updates toggle).
  • 26.11.11 - GitHub Release automation, asset delivery optimizations, and stability improvements.
  • 26.11.10 - Royal Scroll To Top Widget Complete Modernization (4 button types, circular progress ring, live percentage display, smart scroll direction visibility, 3D animations).
  • 26.11.09 - Added Royal Store Locator (Leaflet & OpenStreetMap, zero-API key, live search, categories, Near Me GPS radius, amenities popup, Open Now live filter, structured opening hours, custom pins, turn-by-turn directions, sample JSON download) and Royal Branches Locator (4 layout styles, GIS explorer, live search, CSV export).
  • 26.11.08 - Filterable Post Widget: Post count in filter tabs (parentheses or pill badges), portfolio action button controls (Live Preview, View Details, Both, None), hover clipping fix, extra outer border removal, clean white typography, and mobile height improvements.
  • 26.11.07 - Animated Shape Divider: Full Width Breakout (100vw edge-to-edge even in boxed containers), Snap to Section Edge (0 gap flush pinning), Vertical Shape Dividers (Left and Right positions with dynamic section height sync), and Complete Aesthetic Overhaul (Origami 3D Accordion, smooth sine wave, organic ripples, wide chevrons, seamless infinite loops).
  • 26.11.06 - Fixed middle gap in Wave — Ripple Rhythm (waves_pattern) with seamless 1200px harmonic wave path; Rebuilt Smooth Zigzag (smooth_zigzag) sine wave with clean bounds; Removed editor badge shape label from Elementor canvas.
  • 26.11.05 - Added Royal Divider widget with 10 animated styles (dual-bar, pulse, meteor, liquid flow, etc.); Animated Shape Divider overhaul with 15+ new shapes, 3D multi-layer parallax drift, and universal bidirectional (RTL/LTR) infinite loop animation engine; Fixed live animation playback in Elementor editor and frontend preview; Cleaned section headers by removing all emoji icons.
  • 26.11.01 - Filterable Post Widget modern UI/UX redesign; Portfolio Style overhaul with macOS browser mockup, screenshot scroll, category badges & action buttons; 5 new modern post layouts.
  • 26.10.26 - Added Services Widget; Royal Snippet PHP support; Enhanced CPT Manager UI with display conditions.
  • 26.09.19 - Price List widget improvements: Regular Price, Badges, Item Links, multiple currencies, gap & border controls.
  • 26.08.25 - Royal Snippet editor updated with PHP code support.
